title: Catch-Only-One: Non-Transferable Examples for Model-Specific Authorization
abstract: arXiv:2510.10982v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent AI regulations increasingly emphasize the need for mechanisms that preserve the utility of data for AI innovation while preventing misuse, particularly by enforcing purpose limitation in downstream AI applications. In practice, enforcing this principle remains challenging, as released data can be trivially fed into arbitrary models beyond its declared intent. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this risk by either perturbing data or retraining models to limit unintended use. These strategies, however, offer no protection against inference by unknown or externally trained models, or fundamentally rely on control over the training or deployment. In this work, we introduce non-transferable examples (NTEs), recoded data that act as a task-level "ciphertext" decodable only by a designated model. Whereas adversarial examples exploit directions of high model sensitivity, NTEs leverage the complementary insensitive subspace.

translated_title: Catch-Only-One：面向模型特定授权的不可迁移样本
translated_abstract: 近年来的人工智能法规日益强调需要这样一类机制：既能保持数据对人工智能创新的价值，又能防止数据被滥用，尤其是通过在下游人工智能应用中强制实施“目的限制”原则。然而在实践中，执行这一原则仍然充满挑战，因为已发布的数据可以被轻易地输入到超出其声明用途的任意模型中。现有方法试图通过扰动数据或重新训练模型来限制非预期使用，从而缓解这一风险。但这些策略要么无法防范未知模型或外部训练模型的推理，要么从根本上依赖于对模型训练或部署过程的控制。在这项工作中，我们提出了不可迁移样本（Non-Transferable Examples, NTEs），即经过重新编码的数据，它们充当任务级别的“密文”，只能由指定的模型解码。与对抗样本利用模型高敏感方向不同，NTEs利用的是与之互补的不敏感子空间。
tldr: 本文提出不可迁移样本（NTEs），将数据重新编码为只能被指定模型解码的任务级“密文”，从而实现模型特定的数据授权，在无需控制训练或部署过程的前提下防止数据被未经授权的模型滥用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces non-transferable examples (NTEs), recoded data that act as task-level "ciphertext" decodable only by a designated model, enabling model-specific data authorization that prevents misuse by unauthorized models without requiring control over training or deployment.
